div.div:
Example:
SoC / board = the "platform"
AST2600
├── UART controller # platform device
├── GPIO controller # platform device
├── watchdog # platform device
├── PWM controller # platform device
├── I²C controller # platform device
│ ├── device 1 # I2C device
│ └── device 2 # I2C device
└── PCIe controller # platform device
├── device 3 # PCIe device
└── device 4 # PCIe device
